chapter: New Orleans memories and early drumming
title: Tubby Hall's drumming style and visit to Los Angeles
summary: Tubby came to California with a revue, played a different rhythm and had a famous press roll that Baby Dodds reportedly copied.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California
